evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: "We move quickly" signals bias for action, but "data quality and validation processes to guarantee data accuracy and consistency" introduces a rigour counterbalance.
evidence.domain_risk: "Plan, execute, and evaluate experiments with our marketing and product teams" and "Establish the KPIs and metrics that will be used by the business" — cost of a data error is primarily business decision quality, not regulatory non-compliance.
evidence.jd_authorship: Hiring manager drafted the responsibilities ("SQL, Python, dbt, git, and AWS services", "data integration, ETL, and ELT processes"); a generalist added qualifications boilerplate ("Growth mindset and eagerness to learn new technologies and methodologies", "Strong problem-solving skills").
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: "Design, construct, and enhance data pipelines" + "Establish and implement" + "Establish the KPIs" — primarily greenfield build language.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Single Analytics Engineer hire covering both "design, construct, and enhance data pipelines" and "Establish the KPIs and metrics that will be used by the business" — breadth implies a thin team where individuals own multiple domains.
evidence.collaboration_width: "Tech and product teams" (analytics solutions) and "marketing and product teams" (experiments) are explicitly named; "the business" is referenced generically for KPI monitoring.
evidence.language_gate: Not stated in JD. The benefits section mentions "from learning German to a relocation bonus", implying German is not required.
evidence.urgency: No urgency signals present. Relocation support and visa sponsorship suggest they are actively hiring and prepared to move fast; "freedom to make an impact from day one" implies a quick ramp expectation.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Plan, execute, and evaluate experiments with our marketing and product teams.
evidence.autonomy_level: Establish and implement data requirements and analytics solutions with our tech and product teams.
